# Abstract  

Please report the key findings here.

  
# Data

```{r}
Fistula<-read.sas7bdat("usdat.sas7bdat")

head(Fistula)
summary(Fistula)
#Fistula<-mutate(Fistula,center=as.factor(cc_n))

total.N <-nrow(Fistula)
##Get plot of pre-operative flow mediated dilation vrs week 6 fistula flow rate.
plot(Fistula$flow3~Fistula$fmd_perc)
##Get Gamma regression model for pre-operative flow mediated dilation and week 6 fistula flow rate and p-value.

flow<-glm(data=Fistula,flow3~fmd_perc,family=Gamma(link="log"))
summary(flow)


```
p-value is 0.074 indicating there is no statistical association between between pre-operative flow mediated dilation and week 6 fistula flow rate.


* 
    - Version of data: Auto data from ISLR package is used, and there are `r total.N` total observations included;
    - Exclude models in year 70, and exclude models with weight less than 1700 lbs;
    - Variable definitions: Outcome is "mpg" (miles per gallon), other variables used for analysis are `r colnames(Auto)[2:8]`, and "acceleration" is redefined as $\frac{acceleration+10}{2}$;
    - Cohort construction: 
  
  
```{r}
### create table 
tab.cohort <- data.frame(Criteria = c("Total included","exclude models in year 70","exclude models with weight lower than 1700"),
                         Size = c(total.N,13,13))

### print table 
kable(tab.cohort,caption = "Cohort Construction",row.names = F)
```

```{r}
##### regression analysis

#### full model:

flow2<-glm(data=Fistula,flow3~female+race_black+age_at_surg+diabetes+cad+pad+hist_cvd+chf+alb+dial_surg+bmi+pre_art_diam+pre_vein_diam_min+fmd_perc,family=Gamma(link="log"))
summary(flow2)

flow3<-glm(data=Fistula,flow3~female+race_black+age_at_surg+diabetes+cad+pad+hist_cvd+chf+alb+dial_surg+bmi+pre_art_diam+pre_vein_diam_min+v_diam1+fmd_perc,family=Gamma(link="log"))
summary(flow3)


summary(flow)
#data <- Auto[,which(colnames(Auto)!="name"),]
#fit1 <- lm(mpg~., data = data)
# summary(fit1)
# confint(fit1)
names(Fistula)
tab.mod1 <- data.frame(Variable = rownames(summary(flow)$coefficients),
                       `coefficients(95% CI)` = paste0(round(summary(flow)$coefficients[,1],2),
                                                       " (",
                                                       round(confint(flow)[,1],2),
                                                       ", ",
                                                       round(confint(flow)[,2],2),
                                                       ")"),
                       p = ifelse(summary(flow)$coefficients[,4] < 0.001,"<0.001",round(summary(flow)$coefficients[,4] ,3)))
     
                                                  
#### reduced model:

#fit2 <- lm(mpg~cylinders+displacement+horsepower+weight+year+origin, data = data)
# summary(fit2)
# confint(fit2)
tab.mod2 <- data.frame(Variable = rownames(summary(flow2)$coefficients),
                       `coefficients(95% CI)` = paste0(round(summary(flow2)$coefficients[,1],2),
                                                       " (",
                                                       round(confint(flow2)[,1],2),
                                                       ", ",
                                                       round(confint(flow2)[,2],2),
                                                       ")"),
                       p = ifelse(summary(flow2)$coefficients[,4] < 0.001,"<0.001",round(summary(flow2)$coefficients[,4] ,3)))


tab.mod3 <- data.frame(Variable = rownames(summary(flow3)$coefficients),
                       `coefficients(95% CI)` = paste0(round(summary(flow3)$coefficients[,1],2),
                                                       " (",
                                                       round(confint(flow3)[,1],2),
                                                       ", ",
                                                       round(confint(flow3)[,2],2),
                                                       ")"),
                       p = ifelse(summary(flow3)$coefficients[,4] < 0.001,"<0.001",round(summary(flow3)$coefficients[,4] ,3)))
#### combine two result tables together
tab.result <- merge(tab.mod1,tab.mod2,by="Variable",all.y = T)
colnames(tab.result) <- c("Variable","M1 - Coefficients (95% CI)","M1 - p","M2 - Coefficients (95% CI)","M2 - p")


tab.result1 <- merge(tab.result,tab.mod3,by="Variable",all.y = T)
colnames(tab.result1) <- c("Variable","M1 - Coefficients (95% CI)","M1 - p","M2 - Coefficients (95% CI)","M2 - p","M3 - Coefficients (95% CI)","M3 - p")
### print table into word table format
kable(tab.result1, caption="Table 2. Regression Result", row.names = F)

```
